text:
alice: FYI customer ACME reporting intermittent 502s and long tail timeouts hitting /v1/stream on hostedapi between 12:23-12:25 UTC. Saw ~8% 502 rate for their tenant. sample trace id: trace-0a1b2c3d. Repro curl below.
alice: ```
curl -v --http2 -N \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"hello"}'
```
bob: Can you paste the trace and any upstream ids? Also did this start after the 12:20 deploy? I can pull Envoy logs.
alice: trace-0a1b2c3d, tenant=acme-prod, request id x-req-98765. We noticed errors are mostly on streaming (Transfer-Encoding: chunked / h2). No obvious 5xx from model host logs yet.
eng-sre-bot: alert: envoy.upstream_rq_5xx  spike in cluster edge-midfront at 2026-03-12T12:24:00Z (threshold breached)
chandra: I see a small deploy to auth-cache small refactor at 12:19 that touched upstream keepalive config for midfront. Worth checking h2 keepalive pool exhaustion / connection churn. Kibana query: logs.stream:trace-0a1b2c3d
luis: quick grep from edge-midfront shows a lot of `upstream reset` and `RST_STREAM` around 12:23:57:
luis: ```
[12:23:56] envoy upstream reset while reading response: connection reset by peer id=up-1334
[12:23:57] http2: RST_STREAM received for stream 42, code=2
[12:23:58] upstream request timeout after 3.0s for request x-req-98765
```
bob: That matches keepalive/connpool exhaustion. If many idle sockets dropped during auth-cache churn, midproxy may open many new conns and overflow h2 stream windows. Quick mitigation: bump midfront upstream connection pool, or toggle canary routing off to route to stable pool. Also increase proxy idle timeout to 15s temporarily.
alice: Customer asked for an immediate workaround. Is it safe to recommend: 1) retry with exponential backoff, 2) switch to non-streaming endpoint (blocking) while we triage?
chandra: Yes, recommend non-streaming fallback and client-side retry for now. I'm going to revert the auth-cache keepalive tweak in the canary group and roll it back to stable at 12:32. I'll also open a ticket to increase the default h2 conn pool for midfront.
luis: After rollback we should watch envoy.upstream_rq_5xx and http2.rst metrics. I pushed a transient fix: bumped active_conn_limit for cluster up-1334 to 250 for the canary pool.
alice: thanks — will update ACME support ticket with rollback + suggested client workaround. Posting timeline + trace link to ticket.
bob: follow-up: add a small server-side retry for transient 502s inside the gateway (idempotent detect for streaming?) and add better telemetry to correlate RST_STREAM codes with tenant header.
chandra: agreed, will add to eng backlog. For now, monitoring shows error rate falling after rollback.
alice: :thumbsup: closing loop with customer, will re-open if they see more.
